text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Marine Management Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DEFRA × MARINE MANAGEMENT ORGANISATION DEFRA Marine Management Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of DEFRA Marine Management Organisation — marine licensing, fisheries management, marine planning, marine protected areas, seabed mapping, vessel monitoring, enforcement. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Licensing Marine Licensing — MCZ, EIA, In-Combination Effects Marine licence applications under Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009. MCZ assessment — Conservation of Habitats Regs 2017. EIA screening for marine development. In-combination effect assessment. Licence conditions — mitigation, monitoring, compensation. Exemptions register. Post-consent compliance monitoring. Habitats Regulations Assessment. Appropriate assessment process. Fisheries Fisheries Management — Quota, IVMS, Landing Obligation UK fisheries quota allocation post-Brexit — Fisheries Act 2020. IVMS — Inshore Vessel Monitoring for under-12m fleet. Discard ban / landing obligation enforcement. Catch documentation scheme. Fishing vessel licensing. Fisheries management plans (FMPs). Stock assessment evidence. MSY targets. Joint Fisheries Statement. Planning Marine Planning — Marine Plans, Sustainability Appraisal English marine plans — Marine Policy Statement. Sustainability Appraisal (SA). Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA). Marine plan policies — development, conservation, infrastructure. Plan areas — East, South, North West, NE, SW. Interface with terrestrial LPA. Cumulative effects assessment. Marine plan review and monitoring. Socio-economic impact assessment. MPA Marine Protected Areas — MCZ, SAC, SPA, Monitoring MCZs — designation and management. SACs — Annex I habitats. SPAs — seabird colonies. MPA monitoring — video, grab samples, divers. Conservation advice packages. MPA management measures — byelaws, voluntary. MPA network coherence. Good Environmental Status (GES) indicators. Feature condition assessment. Climate adaptation for MPAs. Seabed Seabed Mapping — Bathymetry, Habitat Survey, JNCC Seabed habitat mapping — EUNIS classification. Bathymetric survey — LiDAR, multibeam, singlebeam. JNCC survey protocols. Seabed sediment classification. Biotope mapping. Sidescan sonar interpretation. Sub-bottom profiler data. Seabed habitat sensitivity mapping. UK SeaMAP. Seabed litter survey. Vessel Vessel Monitoring — AIS, VMS, IUU Fishing Detection AIS — Automatic Identification System. VMS — Vessel Monitoring System for fleet over 12m. IUU fishing detection — illegal, unreported, unregulated. Vessel tracking analytics — speed, course, fishing pattern. Port state control. Transhipment monitoring. Vessel risk scoring. Dark fleet detection. Satellite AIS (S-AIS). Marine domain awareness. Bycatch Bycatch Mitigation — Pingers, BRUVs, Cetacean Monitoring Acoustic deterrent devices (pingers) on gill nets. BRUV — Baited Remote Underwater Video monitoring. Cetacean bycatch reporting — harbour porpoise, common dolphin. Seabird bycatch mitigation — warp scarers, night setting. Marine mammal observer programmes. Bycatch limit thresholds (pBET). Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM). Net mesh modification. Seal depredation management. Aquaculture Aquaculture — Marine Fish Farm Licensing, Environmental Impact Marine fish farm environmental licensing. Salmon farm siting — water quality, current flow. Effluent and waste management. Sea lice treatment — SLICE, H2O2. Escapee management and reporting. Wildlife interactions — seal, cetacean, seabird. Benthic impact monitoring. Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA). Crown Estate lease. Fish health and welfare. Energy Offshore Energy — Marine Licensing for Wind, Cables, Pipelines Offs

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
